name: JF Technology Berhad
overview: JF Technology Berhad 在2026财年未通过公告披露具体的业务板块扩张、新增业务、缩减或出售事项；公告主要涉及股本发行（红股、集资）、股息派发、业绩发布及股东大会等企业活动。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收同比增长113.0%，净利润同比增长436.7%。
overview_en: In FY2026, JF Technology Berhad did not disclose any specific business segment expansion, new business, reduction, or divestment through announcements; announcements mainly involved corporate activities such as share issuances (bonus issues, fund raising), dividend payments, results releases, and general meetings. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw revenue increase by 113.0% year-on-year and net profit increase by 436.7% year-on-year.
